payload.title: Drop the limatus compatibility package: Limatus is Humanus
payload.description: Ryan 2026-11-01: Limatus became Humanus; fix old references. Remove shim/limatus, its release-workflow build step (PyPI refused it with 403 on every release since 0.33.1) and the README note. pip install limatus stays at the last published version on PyPI; nothing new is published under that name.
